bibl.title: Una nuova tipologia vitrea ad Antinoe, Egitto.
bibl.seg: Flora Silvano, Una nuova tipologia vitrea ad Antinoe, Egitto.
bibl.note: The archaeological excavations carried out by the Istituto Papirologico G. Vitelli between 2000 and 2013 in Antinoupolis brought to light different fragments of a particular type of glass bottle called Kuttrolf or guttrolf, dated by the context from the end of the 6th to the 7th centuries.
